title: LAIBench public discrimination ladder
scorer: benchmarkCase, deterministic only (no LLM judge), conservative-min
note: Synthetic public cases, input-only (no answer keys). Each rung injects one error into the reference report; drops are paired against the same case's reference score. Not a clinical validation.

levels.label: Reference
levels.description: Faithful restructuring of the input findings.

levels.label: Measurement drift
levels.description: The first measurement is changed (e.g. 7 mm → 8 mm).

levels.label: Non-critical omission
levels.description: One non-critical abnormal finding is dropped.

levels.label: Laterality swap
levels.description: The first right/left in an abnormal finding is swapped.

levels.label: Critical denied
levels.description: The input's critical finding is written as absent ("No pneumothorax.").

levels.label: Critical omitted
levels.description: Every sentence carrying an input critical finding is dropped; the rest stays polished.

levels.label: Critical fabricated
levels.description: A plausible critical finding the input never states is added.

levels.label: Null report
levels.description: "No acute abnormality." written for an abnormal study.
